purpose: Human/external-access queue for UK TCC CPOs after autonomous discovery. Use this instead of repeating web investigations.
regulatoryNote: UK PCPR requires reference and availability data to be publicly available free of charge and machine-readable, without requiring agreement to terms for use. Some operators nevertheless expose access through account/request/onboarding flows; treat these as access-path facts, not as proof the flows satisfy the regulation.
ecoMovementConsolidationNote: IONITY, evyve, Source EV, ubitricity and bp pulse routes all involve Eco-Movement. A single Eco-Movement technical identity may simplify integration, but operator grants may be scoped; verify scope before assuming one token covers all networks.

items.name: EV Charger Points / Charge & Go
items.humanAction: Email support@evcps.uk with identity, organisation and intended use; operator promises data within 48h.
items.blocker: Operator requires an email request to support@evcps.uk with requester identity, organisation and intended use; operator says data is supplied within 48 hours.
items.next: manual data request only if needed after all autonomous sources are exhausted.

items.name: 3ti Energy Hubs
items.humanAction: No external request yet; recover Fuuse ODA UUID via browser-network inspection once tooling returns.
items.blocker: Official page demonstrably consumes Fuuse ODA data but the client-specific Fuuse UUID/endpoints are injected dynamically and not exposed in static HTML or WordPress REST content. Live browser/network inspection was attempted but could not start because TinyFish wallet balance is -$1.91.
items.next: after browser automation funding is restored, inspect network requests once and persist Fuuse location/tariff URLs.

items.name: LEAP24 UK
items.humanAction: Request Road/E-Flux OCPI data access using already-discovered 2.1.1 endpoints.
items.blocker: Official page currently lists 12 active sites + 5 in development, while external network counts indicate a larger estate. No complete machine-readable PCPR feed surfaced after targeted search.
items.next: try authenticated Road/E-Flux OCPI access or inspect LEAP24 app/backend later; no need to rediscover endpoints.

items.name: GRIDSERVE
